info.name: Student Portal API
info.description: Example login and protected profile requests matching lib/student-auth.ts. Set baseUrl and credentials in a Postman environment.

exec: const token = body.token || body.access_token || body.accessToken || body.data?.token || body.data?.access_token || body.data?.accessToken;
pm.test('Response contains an access token', function () { pm.expect(token, 'token field').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Expected request: POST /auth/login with JSON { email, password }. Expected response: { token } (also supports access_token/accessToken and nested data variants).

exec: pm.test('Protected profile request succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const profile = body.profile || body.user || body.data?.profile || body.data?.user || body.data || body;
pm.test('Profile contains a name or email', function () { pm.expect(profile.name || profile.fullName || profile.full_name || profile.email).to.be.ok; });

request.description: Expected request: GET /auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <token>. Profile response can contain name/fullName, email, studentId, program, yearLevel, and role.
